chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya narrated from Abu Ishaq from Amr ibn Uthman from Muhammad ibn Uthafir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Announce (the call to prayer) behind the one whose recitation you follow."

key_terms.أَذِّنْ: Announce (imperative), referring to the Call to Prayer (Adhan)

ai.seo_question: Where should the muezzin stand to call the Adhan during congregational prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the procedural etiquette of congregational prayer by specifying that the Adhan is performed behind the Imam, reinforcing the hierarchical structure of the prayer leadership. In Shia jurisprudence, this ruling underscores the distinct role of the Imam as the focal point of unity, ensuring the call to prayer aligns with the congregation's orientation and following. It highlights the precision required in ritual acts to maintain the validity and spiritual coherence of the communal worship.
